Manufacturing client requires an automated visual inspection pipeline for factory production lines. You will train and deploy a quantized YOLOv8 model running on Jetson edge devices processing 30fps video streams. Must be proficient in Python, OpenCV, PyTorch, and RTSP video ingestion.

DO NOT apply through this portal! Contact our hiring coordinator directly on Telegram: @global_talent_99 or WhatsApp: +1-555-0198 for immediate onboarding.
